description: This file defines the EmployeeGender class which extends CombinedDisplayField, representing a display field for employee gender information in the HRM system's reporting module. It specifies methods to return associated DTO class, relevant fields, and entity aliases.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents a report display field specifically for employee gender, inheriting behavior from CombinedDisplayField and specifying DTO, fields, and entity aliases relevant to employee gender data.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, which is EmployeeGender.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field identifiers used to fetch or display the employee's gender, here 'employee.gender'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in database queries, such as 'employee'.
